const fs=require('node:fs');fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+(process.env.PORT||8082)+'/status',{headers:{authorization:'Bearer '+process.env.BENCH_CONTROL_TOKEN}}).then(async r=>{if(!r.ok)throw Error('Status error');const status=await r.json();if(status.running)throw Error('Job active');fs.writeFileSync('benchmark/insert-bench.go.txt',Buffer.from("",'base64'));fs.chownSync('benchmark/insert-bench.go.txt',10001,10001);console.log('Installed early and late duplicate benchmark cases before first validation')}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
